headline: Approved one-year Wellspring use agreement for the Saunders House and approved FY2026 audited financial statements.
summary: The art auction's net profit was about $27,000, though numbers are still being tallied. The annual meeting moved to Wednesday, November 18, and amended bylaws will go to that meeting for approval. The Executive Committee will revisit the Wellspring agreement in the next few months.
decisions: Approved a motion to welcome Fran, Jason, Joe, Jen, and Peter L to the meeting, by roll call.
Approved the minutes of August 25, 2026, as amended, by roll call with one abstention.
Approved the FY2026 audited financial statements as presented, by roll call with one abstention.
Approved the Treasurer's Report as presented, by roll call.
Approved changing the date of the 2026 Annual Meeting to Wednesday, November 18, by roll call with one abstention.
Approved the one-year Wellspring use agreement for the Saunders House, with the understanding that the board will meet with the Wellspring Board, by roll call.
Referred the amended bylaws to the annual meeting for approval, by roll call.

decision_titles: Annual Meeting date change to November 18
One-year Wellspring Saunders House use agreement
plain_text:
Page 1 of 3 
 
Gloucester Lyceum & Sawyer Free Library 
Board of Trustees 
Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 5:30 pm  
Sawyer Free Library Conference Room 
2 Dale Avenue, Gloucester, MA 
As the recent amendments to the open meeting law allows, this committee will continue to hold 
meetings remotely. Adequate alternative access to the meeting is provided through the zoom link below. 
And via ZOOM : https://us02web.zoom.us/j/85276115907 
 
Attendance: in person: Geoff Bradford, Peter Brau, Rick Ciolino, John Day, Steven Lewis, Cheryl Marks, 
Katy Marques, Kathleen Reynolds, Dawn Sarrouf, and guests Christine Armstrong, and auditors Christine 
Bruch, and Vince Luccitelli (left at 6:15) 
Via video conference: Fran Aliberte, Jason Brisbois, Joe Grella, Jen Holmgren, Peter Lawrence, and Library 
Director Jenny Benedict 
 
Not Present: Christine Araujo, Jeremy Melvin, Leora Ulrich 
 
 
1. Call to order 
 
2. Welcome and introductions 
a. Peter B moved to welcome Fran, Jason, Joe, Jen, and Peter L to the meeting. Steven seconded 
and the motion was approved via roll call. 
 
3. Approval of minutes from August 25, 2026. Several corrections and clarifications were offered. 
Steven moved to approve the minutes as amended and Peter B seconded. Katy abstained and the 
minutes were approved via roll call.  
 
4. 2026 Audit Report 
a. Peter B described the audit process. The Finance Committee reviewed the auditors’ results 
and approved the statement.  
i. Two significant events in the past year were the merger with the Foundation and 
opening the new building. 
b. Mr. Luccitelli reviewed the report including results of the merger, funding sources for the 
building renovation, and the obligation to the City.  
c. Ms. Bruch reported that there were no substantial issues with operational bookkeeping.  
d. Cheryl moved to approve the FY2026 audited Financial Statements as presented. Kathleen 
seconded. Peter B abstained and the motion was approved via roll call.  
 
5. Treasurer’s Report – Joe 
a. Joe will have a more detailed financial report next month now that the audit is complete. He 
shared an update about the investment accounts.  
b. Kathleen moved to approve the Treasurer’s Report as presented. Dawn seconded and the 
Report was approved via roll call.  
 
6. Fundraising Update – Christine 
a. Christine thanked everyone who attended the art auction on Friday night – an estimated 125-
140 people. Numbers are still being tallied but it looks like the net profit was about $27,000. 
Fran noted that it was also great publicity for the Library. Fran thanked Christine for her work
Page 2 of 3 
 
organizing the event. Fran and Geoff thanked Trustees and staff who helped at the event.  
b. We had enough sponsorships to cover all expenses.  
 
7. Annual Meeting Date and Prep 
a. According to the bylaws the Annual Meeting would be held on Veteran’s Day, November 11th. 
Geoff suggests we move it to Tuesday November 17th instead.  
i. Peter B moved to change the date of this year’s Annual Meeting to Wednesday 
November 18 and John seconded. Dawn abstained and the motion was approved 
via roll call.  
b. Christine has created a calendar for submissions for the Annual Report. The calendar will not 
change in spite of the change to the meeting date. Christine will share the calendar with the 
appropriate people next week. 
c. We will launch the annual appeal at the Annual Meeting.  
d. Please send suggestions for new Corporators to Christine.  
 
8. Wellspring Saunders House Use Agreement – Geoff  
a. The one-year building use agreement with Wellspring has expired. 
b. Geoff reminded Trustees that last year we did not charge Wellspring for use of the building 
because of renovations being done. Since renovations to the Saunders House are still ongoing 
Geoff suggests we not charge them again this year.  
c. Wellspring has requested a two-year agreement. Jenny notes that there are at least two years 
of renovations to be done.  
d. Discussion ensued on whether or not to charge Wellspring. With ongoing renovations we 
frequently ask them to relocate. We keep the building open after hours for them. We could 
ask their Board members for a donation towards rent; or ask Wellspring to find a grant to 
cover rent. We should talk to people at Wellspring about what’s included in their funding for 
the program (maybe they already have a grant to cover space rental) and let them know that 
we are thinking about charging in the future.  
e. Rick moved to approve the agreement for one year with the understanding that we meet with 
the Wellspring Board; discussion will move to the Executive Committee. Steven seconded and 
the motion was approved via roll call.  
f. The Executive Committee will revisit this in the next few months and schedule a meeting with 
the Wellspring board.  
 
9. Committee Reports 
a. Saunders House – Geoff 
i. Fire suppression/sprinklers: work has begun 
b. Lyceum with 
i. Planning for the November AI event is well underway. 
ii. Celebration of Freedom event is being planned for the spring. 
iii. Bylaws update: There was discussion about the number of people on the Lyceum 
Committee. Language regarding Committee make-up was agreed upon. 
• Peter B moved to forward the bylaws, as amended, to the annual 
meeting for approval. Kathleen seconded and the motion was approved 
via roll call.  
 
10. Next Meeting: October 27, 2026 
 
11. 7:15 Adjourn. There being no further business the meeting was adjourned. 
 
Respectfully submitted, Tracy Bowen
Page 3 of 3 
 
 
 
Motions Summary 
Cheryl moved to approve the FY2026 audited Financial Statements as presented. Kathleen seconded. Peter 
B abstained and the motion was approved via roll call.  
 
Kathleen moved to approve the Treasurer’s Report as presented. Dawn seconded and the Report was 
approved via roll call.  
 
Peter B moved to change the date of this year’s Annual Meeting to Wednesday November 18 and John 
seconded. Dawn abstained and the motion was approved via roll call.  
 
Rick moved to approve the agreement with Wellspring for one year with the understanding that we meet 
with the Wellspring Board; discussion will move to the Executive Committee. Steven seconded and the 
motion was approved via roll call.  
 
Peter B moved to forward the bylaws, as amended, to the annual meeting for approval. Kathleen seconded 
and the motion was approved via roll call.  
 
 
 
Actions Summary 
Please send suggestions for new Corporators to Christine. 
 
The Executive Committee will revisit the agreement with Wellspring in the next few months and schedule a 
meeting with the Wellspring board.
